page.title: OurTaiko · A shared love of rhythm
page.description: Explore OurTaikoPlay, OurTaikoView_Web, OurTaikoFanmade and OurTaikoTournaments. Play, share charts and join the taiko community.
hero.title: A shared love of rhythm
hero.description: From your first Don to your next meetup. Play, explore charts, create and compete. Find your rhythm here.
products.label: Projects
products.title: Four ways.
products.intro:
From solo practice to sharing the stage.
More ways to enjoy taiko, together.
play.description: A familiar Nijiiro-style rhythm game, ready for keyboard or touch. Bring local TJA charts or connect to online libraries and play your favorite songs.
view.description: Watch charts or practice right in your browser. Use autoplay, change speed and jump between measures to work on the sections you want to master.
view.note: Integrated into Fanmade. Open the player from a chart page.
fanmade.description: Turn an idea into your next chart. Browse, upload, preview and share custom creations. Discover what the community makes and take your favorites with you.
tournaments.description: Bring your love of taiko to the stage. Explore tournaments, brackets and results, then relive the highlights through event galleries.
community.label: Community
community.title: The next Don is yours.
community.description: Taiko brought us together. Try our projects, share an idea or help us build what comes next. There’s a place for you here.
footer.tagline: Brought together by taiko. Inspired to create.
footer.notice: Unofficial fan projects. Not affiliated with Bandai Namco.
